title: Preserve the default RAW look in NIND and save denoised TIFFs without a second curve
source: rapidroom (original implementation with Codex; shared RAW GPU renderer)
notes: Legacy RGB NIND receives encoded RGB consistently: RAWs first use the actual default RAW GPU view, including its display tone mapping, and normal RGB files pass through once. Saved RAW-derived TIFFs preserve that default look without the former gamma 2.38/contrast 1.28 approximation or a second curve. Every quality setting retains a halo and overlap; higher quality uses a larger discarded border. Other denoise methods are unchanged. Seam geometry and whole-image colour restoration are tracked separately under issue 172.
